title: 'Flat', 'tired', 'cynical': Unusually gloomy Kiwis deliver New Zealand's tightest election in years
english: New Zealanders recently held one of their closest elections ever amidst a national mood of widespread apathy, economic frustration, and disillusionment. Voters increasingly moved away from the two main political parties, resulting in a fragmented outcome where smaller parties now hold significant influence. The incoming government faces the difficult task of addressing deep-seated concerns regarding the cost of living, declining economic prospects, and a waning sense of national optimism.

oromo: Niiwuu Ziilaanditti filannoon kun kan ta'e uummanni hedduun abdii kutannaa, rakkoo dinagdee fi quubsumaa dhabuun erga itti dhaga'amee booda. Namoonni hedduun paartilee gurguddoo lamaan irraa fagaachuun deggarsa isaanii paartilee xixiqqootti jijjiiruu isaaniitiin bu'aan filannichaa kan hin murtoofne ta'eera. title: Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi missiles targeting Riyadh, Eastern province
english: Saudi Arabia’s air defense systems successfully intercepted several ballistic and cruise missiles launched by Houthi forces toward Riyadh and the Eastern province. These attacks occur amid escalating violence in Yemen, where government forces are attempting to reclaim territory from the rebels. Simultaneously, Houthi officials reported that a coalition airstrike near Sanaa resulted in the deaths of 33 civilians, including many women and children.
amharic: የሳውዲ አረቢያ የአየር መከላከያ ሰራዊት በሪያድ እና በምስራቃዊው ግዛት ላይ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የተተኮሱ በርካታ የባሊስቲክ እና የክሩዝ ሚሳኤሎችን መትቶ መጣል ችሏል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የየመን መንግስት ሃይሎች ከአማፂያን ግዛት ለመረከብ በሚያደርጉት ጥረት መካከል እየተባባሰ በመጣው ግጭት ውስጥ የተፈጸሙ ናቸው። በተመሳሳይ፣ የሁቲ ባለስልጣናት በሳና አቅራቢያ በተፈጸመ የቅንጅት ጥቃት ሴቶችን እና ህጻናትን ጨምሮ 33 ሲቪሎች መገደላቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa qilleensaa Sa'udii Arabaa meeshaa waraanaa gosa mizaayilii balistikii fi kireezii humnoota Huutii gara Riyaad fi naannoo bahaatti dhukaafaman qilleensa irratti gubee balleesseera. Hojiin waraanaa kun kan raawwatame yeroo waraanni mootummaa Yemen naannolee Huutii harka jiran deebisanii to'achuuf socho'aa jiranitti. Gam biraan, mootummaan Huutii haleellaa qilleensaa kutaaleen waraanaa gamtaa sanaa bukkee Sana'aa irratti raawwataniin namoota nagaa 33 kan ta'an, dhiira, dubartoota fi ijoollee kan dabalatu du'uu isaanii beeksisaniiru.

title: Photos: Heavy rains leave tens of thousands without shelter in Gaza
english: Severe rainfall has flooded tens of thousands of makeshift tents across Gaza, leaving many displaced families without adequate shelter. Local emergency services are struggling to provide aid due to a critical lack of equipment and the ongoing restrictions on humanitarian support. Authorities have issued an urgent plea to international organizations for immediate assistance to address the deepening crisis.

Tajaajilli ariifachiisaa naannichaa meeshaalee gahaa dhabuu fi dhiyeessii gargaarsa namoomaa irratti gufuun waan jiruuf, namoota miidhaman gargaaruun isaaniif ulfaataa ta'eera. Aangeyyoonni mootummaa haala hamaa kana keessatti gargaarsa hatattamaa akka argataniif dhaabbilee idil-addunyaatti waamicha dhiyeessaniiru.

title: Is unconditional support for Israel becoming a liability for Republicans?
english: Following a significant defeat in the recent midterm elections, some Republican leaders are questioning the party's long-standing policy of unconditional support for Israel. Vice President JD Vance explicitly identified concerns over the U.S.-Israel relationship as a factor that drove voters away from the party. This shift suggests that the traditional Republican consensus on foreign policy may be changing as the party evaluates its future political strategy.

oromo: Filannoo giddu-galeessa waggaa dhiheenya kana gaggeeffame irratti injifannoo dhabuun hordofee, hogganoonni paartii Ripaabilikaanii tokko tokko deeggarsa Israa'eliif taasisan kan hin miiroomne ta'uu isaa irratti shakkii kaasaa jiru. title: There is reason to hope that the Democrats might deliver this time
english: Following the recent US midterm elections, voters have provided the Democratic Party with a renewed opportunity after rejecting Trumpism. The author notes that Democrats achieved success by focusing more on progressive economic populism and supporting working-class interests rather than traditional neoliberal policies. Success in future cycles now depends on whether the party can effectively deliver on these promises to avoid further voter backlash.
amharic: በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የአሜሪካ የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ መራጮች የትራምፕን አስተሳሰብ ውድቅ በማድረግ ለዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ሌላ እድል ሰጥተዋል። ደራሲው እንደሚገልጸው ዴሞክራቶች ስኬታማ የሆኑት ከቀድሞው የኒዮሊበራል ፖሊሲዎች በመውጣት ለሰራተኛው ክፍል በሚጠቅሙ የኢኮኖሚ ጉዳዮች ላይ በማተኮራቸው ነው። ፓርቲው የገባውን ቃል በተግባር ካላሳየ ግን ወደፊት ለተመሳሳይ የህዝብ ተቃውሞ ሊጋለጥ እንደሚችል ተጠቁሟል።

Barreessaan akka ibsetti, Demookraatonni bu'aa argatan kan danda'ame ilaalcha diinagdee gara fuulduraatti tarkaanfatuufi faayidaa hojjettootaarratti xiyyeeffachuudhaan malee, siyaasa durii hordofuudhaan miti. Paartichi abdii kenne kana qabatamaan raawwachuu baannaan, gara fuulduraatti mormii filattootaa akkaan mudachuu danda'a.

title: Haitians cheer El Salvador’s Bukele amid gang war
english: Many Haitians are expressing support for El Salvador’s President Nayib Bukele as he considers intervening in Haiti's severe gang crisis. This interest follows Bukele's commitment to dismantle criminal organizations after several Salvadoran citizens were abducted. Residents in the violence-plagued capital are looking toward his aggressive security approach as a potential solution to restore order.
amharic: የሄይቲ ነዋሪዎች በሀገሪቱ የፈጠረውን የቡድን ወንጀል ለመቅረፍ የኤል ሳልቫዶሩ ፕሬዝዳንት ናይብ ቡኬሌ ጣልቃ እንዲገቡ ድጋፋቸውን እየገለጹ ነው። ይህ የሆነው አራት የኤል ሳልቫዶር ዜጎች ታግተው በመወሰዳቸው ምክንያት ፕሬዝዳንቱ ወንጀለኛ ቡድኖችን ሙሉ በሙሉ ለማጥፋት ቃል በመግባታቸው ነው። በወንጀለኞች ቁጥጥር ስር ለወደቀችው የሄይቲ ዋና ከተማ ነዋሪዎች፣ የፕሬዝዳንቱ ጠንካራ የጸጥታ እርምጃ መፍትሄ ይሆናል ብለው ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ።
oromo: Haitii keessatti namoonni baay'een mootummaan isaanii rakkoo garee yakkaatiin guutamuu isaa hordofee, pirezidaantiin El Saalvaadoor Nayib Bukele gargaarsa akka godhaniif deggersa isaanii ibsaa jiru. Kuni kan ta'e erga lammiileen El Saalvaadoor afur butamanii booda, pirezidaant Bukele garee yakkaatiin guutummaatti barbadeessuuf waadaa seenuun isaanii hordofeeti. Jiraattonni magaalaa guddittii badii garee yakkattiin miidhaman, tarkaanfiin nageenyaa kan pirezidaantichaa furmaata ta'a jedhanii abdatu.

title: Morning update
english: The Middle East is facing heightened tension as Saudi-led forces intercepted missile attacks near Riyadh, while civilian casualties rise from airstrikes in Yemen. The United States is launching a new task force to monitor Iranian weapon movements, leading to stern warnings from Iranian officials. Additionally, regional developments include an execution in Iran, maritime rescue operations in the Sea of Oman, and diplomatic discussions aimed at stabilizing the area.

oromo: Naannoo Baha Giddu-galeessatti humnoonni Sa’udii durfaman xiyyara gosa misaa’elaa biyya ishee irratti dhukaafame erga fashalsanii booda rakkoon tasgabbii dabalaa dhufeera. Yaman keessatti haleellaa qilleensaan lubbuun namoota baay’ee darbee kan jiru yoo ta’u, Ameerikaan ammoo sochii meeshaa waraanaa Iraan to’achuuf garee addaa hundeeffatteetti. Iraan tarkaanfii kanaan walqabatee akeekkachiisa cimaa kan kennite yoo ta’u, gama biraatiin mariin dippilomaasii fi haalli nageenyaa naannichaa xiyyeeffannoo argataa jira.

title: Palestinian injured, six others detained during raids in West Bank
english: Israeli forces conducted military raids across the West Bank, resulting in one Palestinian youth being shot and wounded in Qalqilya after clashes involving stone-throwing. During these operations, soldiers also damaged a private home and arrested six individuals in Jenin and near Nablus. The Israeli military confirmed they engaged targets following confrontations with local residents.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ ባደረጉት ወረራ አንድ ወጣት በካልኪሊያ ከተማ በጥይት ተመቷል። በዚህ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ወቅት ወታደሮቹ የአንድን ቤተሰብ ቤት መውረራቸውንና ንብረት ማውደማቸውን የተዘገበ ሲሆን በጀኒን እና በናብሉስ አቅራቢያ ስድስት ፍልስጤማውያን ታስረዋል። የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በከተማዋ ከተፈጠረው ድንጋይ የመወርወር ግጭት በኋላ ግለሰቦች ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸሙን አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el naannoo Qaxxaamuraa Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti weerara gaggeessaniin dargaggeessi tokko magaalaa Qalqiyaa keessatti rasaasaan rukutamee madaa'eera. Hojiilee kana gidduutti, waraanni mana dhuunfaa tokko miidhuu fi namoota ja'a godina Jenin fi Nablus biratti qabuu gabaafameera. Humnoonni Israa'el garee namootaa dhagaa darbatan irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuu isaanii mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Aramco building damaged as Houthis target Riyadh, report says
english: A building belonging to the oil giant Aramco was damaged in Riyadh's financial district following a missile attack. While Saudi-led forces stated they successfully intercepted projectiles in the air, witnesses confirmed that the site suffered visible impacts. Loud explosions were heard throughout the capital city after authorities issued emergency warnings about the incoming threat.
amharic: በሪያድ የፋይናንስ ማዕከል የሚገኝ የአራምኮ ሕንፃ በደረሰ የሮኬት ጥቃት ጉዳት ደርሶበታል። የሳዑዲ ጥምረት ኃይሎች ሚሳይሎችን በአየር ላይ መትተው እንደጣሉ ቢገልጹም፣ በአካባቢው የነበሩ ምስክሮች በሕንፃው ላይ ጉዳት መድረሱን አረጋግጠዋል። ባለስልጣናት የደህንነት ማስጠንቀቂያ ከሰጡ በኋላ በከተማዋ የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ከፍተኛ የፍንዳታ ድምፆች ተሰምተዋል።
oromo: Masaraan dhaabbata boba'aa Aramco kan magaalatti Riyaad keessatti argamu, haleellaa rookeettiin iddoo kuusaa maallaqaa irratti raawwatameen miidhamuu gabaasameera. Humnoonni gamtaa Sa'udii rookeettiiwwan qilleensa keessatti akka barbadeessan dubbatanis, ragaan biyya lafaa miidhaa qaqqabe mirkaneessaniiru. Aangoonni biyyattii akeekkachiisa yeroo muddamaa erga labsanii booda, magaalaa guddoo sana keessatti sagaleen dhoohinsa cimaa dhaga'ameera.

title: UK petition seeking Gaza genocide inquiry nears parliament debate threshold
english: A petition in the UK urging a formal investigation into the country's role in the conflict in Gaza has gained 90,000 signatures. Once the total reaches 100,000, the proposal will be eligible for a mandatory debate in the British Parliament. Initiated by Your Party, the movement aims to hold government officials accountable for potential involvement in military actions, including arms sales and the use of air bases.
amharic: በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነት የብሪታንያ ተሳትፎ ላይ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ የሚጠይቅ አቤቱታ 90,000 ፊርማዎችን አግኝቷል። አጠቃላይ ቁጥሩ 100,000 ሲደርስ ጉዳዩ በፓርላማ ተወያይቶበት ውሳኔ እንዲሰጥበት ይገደዳል። በ'ዩር ፓርቲ' የተጀመረው ይህ ጥረት መንግሥት የጦር መሣሪያ አቅርቦትንና ሌሎች ወታደራዊ እገዛዎችን ጨምሮ በተለያዩ ጉዳዮች ላይ ተጠያቂ እንዲሆን ይፈልጋል።
oromo: UK keessatti gaaffiin qorannoo irratti godhamuu qabu kan biyyattiin waraana Gaaza keessatti qabdu adda baasuuf gargaaru 90,000 gaheera. Walumaagalatti mallattoon 100,000 yoo guute, dhimmi kun parlamaan irratti akka mari'atuuf dirqama ta'a. 'Your Party'n kan jalqabame kun, mootummaan meeshaalee waraanaa dhiyeessuu fi gargaarsa waraanaa biroo irratti gaafatamaa akka ta'u gaafata.

title: Coalition forces says four Houthi missiles destroyed over Saudi airspace
english: The Saudi-led coalition successfully intercepted four Houthi-launched missiles targeting various areas of Saudi Arabia, including Riyadh and the southern region. According to a coalition spokesperson, the defense systems destroyed two ballistic missiles and two cruise missiles mid-air. There were no reports of damage or casualties resulting from these thwarted aerial attacks.
amharic: በሳውዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ወደ ሳውዲ አረቢያ የተተኮሱ አራት ሚሳኤሎችን በአየር ላይ መትቶ ጥሏል። የጥምረቱ ቃል አቀባይ እንደገለጹት፣ ሁለቱ ባሊስቲክ እና ሁለቱ የክሩዝ ሚሳኤሎች በሪያድ እና በደቡባዊ የሳውዲ ክፍል ላይ ተintercept ተደርገው ተደምስሰዋል። በዚህ ጥቃት ምንም አይነት የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት ወይም የንብረት ውድመት አልተመዘገበም።
oromo: Mootummoota gamtoomaniin kan durfamu humni waraanaa, kombii Hutiin gara biyya Sa'udii Arabaatti ergaman miseelota afur qilleensa irratti caccabseera. Akka dubbi himaan humna waraana kanaa ibsetti, miseelota baalistikii lamaafi miseelota kiruuzii lama kanneen gara Riyaadiifi kibba biyyattii qajeelfaman qilleensa irratti fashala'aniiru. Haleellaa kanaan miidhaan lubbuufi qabeenyaa irra ga'e akka hin jirre ibsameera.

title: Gold-fed Cash Drags Treasury Yields Far Below the Policy Rate
english: The National Bank of Ethiopia is preparing for an upcoming monetary policy meeting to address the gap between its set interest rates and market borrowing costs. Recent treasury bill auctions and government gold purchasing plans are influencing liquidity and debt dynamics. Financial authorities are closely monitoring these economic factors to determine whether current policy rates remain aligned with real-world market conditions.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ብሔራዊ ባንክ ባስቀመጠው የወለድ መጠን እና በገበያ ላይ ባለው የመበደር ዋጋ መካከል ያለውን ልዩነት ለመገምገም ለሚቀጥለው የገንዘብ ፖሊሲ ስብሰባ እየተዘጋጀ ነው። በቅርቡ የተካሄዱ የጨረታ ውጤቶች እና የመንግስት የወርቅ ግዢ እቅዶች በገበያው ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደሩ ይገኛሉ። የፋይናንስ ባለስልጣናት አሁን ያለው የፖሊሲ ወለድ መጠን ከገበያው ሁኔታ ጋር የተጣጣመ መሆኑን ለማረጋገጥ መረጃዎችን በቅርበት እየተከታተሉ ነው።
oromo: Baankiin Biyyaalessaa Itoophiyaa qabxii woliiggaltee qabxiilee dhabuu gatii liqii mootummaa fi qajeelfama baankichaa gidduu jiru fooyyessuuf mariiwwan fuulduraaf qophaa'aa jira. Ibsiwwan baajataa fi karoora bitii warqee mootummaa dhiyeenya kana raawwataman dhiyeessii maallaqaa fi gatii liqii irratti dhiibbaa uumaa jiru. Qaamoleen maallaqaa qajeelfamni amma jiru gabaa fi haala dinagdee biyyattii wajjin kan wal-simatu ta'uu isaa mirkaneessuuf haala qabatamaa gabaa hordofaa jiru.

title: A CITY THAT RATIONS WATER SELLS IT TWICE
english: Residents of Addis Ababa are facing severe water shortages, receiving tap water only once or twice a week. Because of this scarcity, families and small businesses are forced to spend significant money on expensive private water tankers and bottled water. Bottling companies claim that high costs for fuel, plastic, and taxes have made water prices increasingly unaffordable for the public.
amharic: የአዲስ አበባ ነዋሪዎች የቧንቧ ውሃ በሳምንት አንድ ወይም ሁለት ጊዜ ብቻ በማግኘታቸው ከፍተኛ የውሃ እጥረት እየገጠማቸው ነው። በዚህ ችግር ምክንያት ቤተሰቦችና ትናንሽ የንግድ ተቋማት ውድ የሆነ የውሃ ቦቴ እና የታሸገ ውሃ ለመግዛት ተገደዋል። የውሃ አምራች ኩባንያዎች በበኩላቸው የነዳጅ፣ የፕላስቲክ እና የታክስ ጭማሪ ዋጋው እንዲወደድ ማድረጉን ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Jiraattonni Finfinnee bishaan burcuqqoo torbanitti al tokko ykn lama qofa argachaa waan jiraniif, rakkoo bishaan dhabuu hamaa keessa jiru. Hanqina kanaan kan ka’e, maatiinifi qonnaan bultoonni bishaan konkolataan dhuufuufi bishaan qaruuraatiif baasii guddaa baasuuf dirqamaniiru. Warreen bishaan qaruuraatti guuran ammoo gatiin boba'aa, pilaastikiifi taaksiin dabaluun isaa gatii bishaanichaa akka mi'aayu taasiseera jedhu.

title: Before WTO Entry, Ethiopia’s Quality System Faces a Test
english: Ethiopia is currently working toward joining the World Trade Organization, but it faces significant challenges in meeting global trade standards. A government official recently admitted that the country lacks the necessary modern laboratory equipment, skilled professionals, and institutional coordination to support businesses effectively. Addressing these infrastructure and capacity gaps is critical for the nation's successful integration into the international trade market.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ የዓለም የንግድ ድርጅትን ለመቀላቀል ጥረት እያደረገች ቢሆንም፣ ዓለም አቀፍ የንግድ ደረጃዎችን ለማሟላት ከፍተኛ ፈተናዎች ገጥመዋታል። የመንግስት የስራ ኃላፊዎች እንደገለጹት አገሪቱ ንግድን በብቃት ለመደገፍ የሚያስፈልጉ ዘመናዊ የላብራቶሪ መሣሪያዎች፣ የሰለጠኑ ባለሙያዎች እና የተጠናከረ ተቋማዊ ትብብር እንደሌላት አምነዋል። እነዚህን የመሠረተ ልማት እና የአቅም ክፍተቶች መፍታት አገሪቱ በአለም አቀፍ የንግድ ስርዓት ውስጥ በተሳካ ሁኔታ ለመሳተፍ ወሳኝ ነው።
oromo: Itoophiyaan dhaabbata daldalaa addunyaa (WTO) makamuuf carraaqqii gochaa jirtus, sadarkaa daldalaa addunyaa guutuuf rakkoo guddaa keessa jirti. Akka qondaalonni mootummaa ibsanitti, biyyattiin daldala deeggaruuf meeshaalee laaboraatoorii ammayyaa, ogeeyyii gahumsa qaban fi walitti hidhamiinsa dhaabbilee barbaachisu akka hin qabne beekameera. Rakkoolee bu'uuraa fi dandeettii kana furuun, biyyattiin sirna daldala addunyaa keessatti milkaa'inaan akka hirmaattuuf baay'ee barbaachisaadha.

title: Regulators to Let Banks Guard Foreign Investors’ Assets without Subsidiaries
english: The Ethiopian Capital Market Authority and the National Bank are working on a new policy allowing commercial banks to act as custodians for foreign investors' assets. Under this proposed framework, banks would manage these securities within internal, isolated departments rather than having to create separate subsidiary companies. This shift aims to bypass previous restrictions that prevented banks from offering such capital market services directly.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ካፒታል ገበያ ባለስልጣን እና የኢትዮጵያ ብሔራዊ ባንክ የንግድ ባንኮች ለውጭ ባለሀብቶች የንብረት ጠባቂነት አገልግሎት እንዲሰጡ የሚያስችል አዲስ መመሪያ እያዘጋጁ ነው። በዚህ አዲስ አሰራር መሰረት ባንኮቹ የተለየ ቅርንጫፍ ሳይከፍቱ በራሳቸው የውስጥ ክፍል ውስጥ የባለሀብቶችን ደህንነቶች በጥንቃቄ መያዝ ይችላሉ። ይህ እርምጃ ባንኮች በቀጥታ የካፒታል ገበያ አገልግሎት እንዳይሰጡ የሚከለክለውን ቀደም ሲል የነበረውን ገደብ ለማሻሻል ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Abbaan taayitaa gabaa kaappitaalaa Itoophiyaa fi Baankiin Biyyooleessa Itoophiyaa, baankonni daldalaa qabeenya invastoroota alaa akka eegan hayyamuuf qajeelfama haaraa qopheessaa jiru. Haala kana jalatti, baankonni garee addaa ykn 'subsidiary' osoo hin hundeesseen, qabeenya invastorootaa keessa isaaniitti bakka adda baafamee fi eegame keessatti bulchuu danda'u. Jijjiiramni kun, kanaan dura baankonni tajaajila gabaa kaappitaalaa qajeeltodhaan akka hin kennine dhorkaa ture haquuf kan yaadame dha.

title: Fed Cushions Oil Shock with Money Already in the Pipeline
english: The Ethiopian government is managing the impact of rising oil prices by repurposing 543 million dollars from existing World Bank development funds. This strategy aims to stabilize domestic fuel supplies and maintain the flow of critical imports without requiring new emergency loans. The allocated amount is valued at approximately 86.7 billion Birr based on current exchange rates.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ መንግስት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የተከሰተውን የነዳጅ ዋጋ ንረት ተፅእኖ ለመቀነስ ቀደም ሲል ከዓለም ባንክ የተገኘን 543 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ወደ ነዳጅ አቅርቦት ስራዎች በማዞር ላይ ይገኛል። ይህ እርምጃ አዲስ የብድር እዳ ሳይወስድ የሀገር ውስጥ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት መስተጓጎልን ለመቅረፍ እና አስፈላጊ የሆኑ የውጭ ምርቶች በየጊዜው እንዲገቡ ለማስቻል ታስቦ የተዘጋጀ ነው። የተጠቀሰው ገንዘብ አሁን ባለው የምንዛሬ ተመን ወደ 86.7 ቢሊዮን ብር ገደማ ይገመታል።
oromo: Mootummaan Itoophiyaa miidhaa gabaa boba'aa giddu galeessa bahaa irraa dhufu hir'isuuf, maallaqa World Bank irraa argamee fi pirojektoota misoomaa adda addaaf qabame ture miiliyoona 543 gara dhiyeessii boba'aatti jijjiirachaa jira. Tarkaanfiin kun liqii haaraa osoo hin fudhatin dhiyeessii boba'aa biyya keessaa tasgabbeessuu fi meeshaalee barbaachisoo ta'an gara biyyaa galchuuf kan gargaaru dha. Maallaqni kun yeroo ammaa gatii jijjiirraa maallaqaan yoo shallagamu gara biliyoona 86.7 ta'a.

title: Canary Islands’ El Hierro declares emergency amid migrant, refugee influx
english: The Canary Island of El Hierro has officially declared an emergency due to a massive surge in migrants arriving by boat from West Africa. Since early November, over 3,300 people have reached the island, severely straining local medical facilities and resources. Regional leaders are calling for urgent support from the Spanish central government to manage the unsustainable situation and provide adequate care for the new arrivals.
amharic: የስፔኑ የካናሪ ደሴት የሆነችው ኤል ሂሮ ከምዕራብ አፍሪካ በጀልባ የሚመጡ ስደተኞች ቁጥር በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ በመጨመሩ የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ አውጇል። ከህዳር ወር መጀመሪያ አንስቶ ከ3,300 በላይ ሰዎች ደሴቲቱ ላይ በመድረሳቸው የጤና ተቋማት እና የአካባቢው ሀብቶች ከፍተኛ ጫና ውስጥ ወድቀዋል። የክልሉ አስተዳዳሪዎች ሁኔታው አሳሳቢ እና የማይቀጥል መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ ከስፔን ማዕከላዊ መንግስት አስቸኳይ እርዳታ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Odolli Ispeen kan ta'e El Hiyeroo, godaantotni Afrikaa Dhihaa irraa dooniin dhufan lakkoofsaan dabaluu isaatiin walqabatee labsii yeroo ariifachiisaa labseera. Hagayyaa jalqabaa kaasee namootni 3,300 ol ta'an odola kana ga'uun isaanii, tajaajila fayyaa fi qabeenya naannichaa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumeera. Hogganootni naannichaa haalli kun kan itti fufuu hin dandeenye ta'uu ibsuun, mootummaan giddugaleessa Ispeen deeggarsa hatattamaa akka taasisuuf gaafataniiru.

title: Polish PM calls deadly Krakow shooting an act of ‘terrorism’
english: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has labeled a violent shooting incident in Krakow as an act of terrorism. The attack resulted in the deaths of six individuals and left 15 others injured. Additionally, authorities discovered three more bodies at the suspect's residence, which are believed to be those of his family members.
amharic: የፖላንድ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ዶናልድ ቱስክ በክራኮው ከተማ የደረሰውን ገዳይ የተኩስ ልውውጥ የሽብር ተግባር ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። ጥቃቱ ስድስት ሰዎችን ለህልፈት የዳረገ ሲሆን ሌሎች 15 ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በተጨማሪም ባለስልጣናት በተጠርጣሪው ቤት ውስጥ የቤተሰቡ አባላት ናቸው ተብለው የሚጠረጠሩ ሶስት ተጨማሪ አስከሬኖች ተገኝተዋል።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa Poolaand Donaald Tuusk miidhaa dhukaasaa magaalaa Kraakoow keessatti raawwatamee fi lubbuu darbe akka gocha shororkeessummaa tokkootti ibsaniiru. Dhukaasa kanaan namoonni ja’a du’anii 15 ammoo madaa’aniiru. Kana malees, qaamoleen nageenyaa mana shakkamaa sanaa keessatti reeffa namoota sadii kanneen miseensa maatii isaa ta’uu malu jedhamee shakkamu argataniiru.

title: Iran war live: Blasts heard in Qeshm; US moves to block land supply routes
english: Explosions have been reported across several Iranian locations, including Qeshm Island and various coastal cities near the Strait of Hormuz. In response to rising tensions, the United States has launched a new task force aimed at cutting off Iran's land supply chains. This initiative expands upon existing American efforts to restrict Iranian maritime trade in the region.
amharic: በኢራን የሆርሙዝ ባህር ወሽመጥ አቅራቢያ በሚገኙ የቃሽም ደሴት እና ሌሎች የባህር ዳርቻ ከተሞች ፍንዳታዎች እንደተሰሙ የሀገሪቱ የመገናኛ ብዙኃን ዘግበዋል። ለዚህም ምላሽ አሜሪካ የኢራንን የመሬት አቅርቦት መስመሮች ለመዝጋት የሚያስችል አዲስ እቅድ ይፋ አድርጋለች። ይህ እርምጃ ቀደም ሲል በባህር ላይ ሲያደርጉት የነበረውን ማዕቀብ የበለጠ የሚያጠናክር ነው።
oromo: Magaalota Iran kanneen akka qarqara galaana Hormuz fi qe'ee Qeshm keessatti dhoohaan guddaan dhaga'ameera jedhamee gabaafameera. Haala kanaan walqabatee, Ameerikaan daandiiwwan gurguddaa Iran gara lafaa fayyadamtu cufuuf karoorri haaraan akka ba'e ibsiteetti. Tarkaanfiin kunis uggura Ameerikaan bishaan irra tursiifte cimsanii itti fufuuf kan karoorfameedha.

title: Eisenkot chosen over Netanyahu to form Israel’s next government
english: Israel's president has selected opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot to organize the country's upcoming government instead of the incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. This decision highlights a significant political shift, as diverse political factions have unified in their opposition to Netanyahu's leadership. The move marks a major change in the Israeli political landscape as they move toward forming a new administration.
amharic: የእስራኤል ፕሬዚዳንት የአገሪቱን ቀጣይ መንግስት እንዲመሰርቱ ከተቃዋሚው መሪ ጋዲ አይዘንኮት ጋር መግባባት ላይ ደርሰዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ አስተዳደር ጋር የተለየ አቋም ያላቸው የተለያዩ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች በመቀናጀታቸው የተገኘ ውጤት ነው። ይህ እርምጃ አዲስ መንግስት ለመመስረት በሚደረገው ጥረት በእስራኤል ፖለቲካ ውስጥ ትልቅ ለውጥን ያሳያል።
oromo: Pirezidantiin Israa'el mootummaa biyyattii itti aanu akka hundeessan hoggantoota mormituu keessaa Gadii Ayizenkootiif carraa kennaniiru. Murteen kun kan agarsiisu, gareeleen siyaasaa adda addaa gita-bitoota Benjamin Neetanyaahutti mormuu isaanii irraa kan ka'e tokkummaan dhaabbachuu isaanii ti. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyattii keessatti mootummaa haaraa hundeessuuf jijjiirama siyaasaa guddaa geessiseera.

title: French ships may escort pro-Palestinian civilian flotillas, Mélenchon says
english: French politician Jean-Luc Mélenchon has proposed using French ships to escort civilian flotillas aiming to provide aid to Palestinians. He stated this initiative is intended to oppose the ongoing violence in Gaza and the annexation of territories like the West Bank and southern Lebanon. Mélenchon emphasized his commitment to taking direct action to protect these regions and support persecuted communities in the area.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ፖለቲከኛ ዣን-ሉክ ሜለንቾን ወደ ፍልስጤም እርዳታ የሚያደርሱ የሲቪል መርከቦችን የፈረንሳይ የባህር ኃይል እንዲያጅብ ሐሳብ አቅርበዋል። ይህ እርምጃ በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት እንዲሁም የዌስት ባንክ እና የደቡብ ሊባኖስ ግዛቶችን መያዝ ለመቃወም የታለመ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ሜለንቾን እነዚህን ክልሎች ለመጠበቅ እና ችግር ላይ ያሉ ማህበረሰቦችን ለመደገፍ ቀጥተኛ እርምጃዎችን እንደሚወስድ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Poliitikaan biyya Faransaay Zhaan-Luuk Meelenchoon, markaboolee namoota sivilii gara Falasxiin gargaarsa geessan hordofuu fi eeguuf markaboota Faransaay fayyadamuuf yaada dhiyeessaniiru. Tarkaanfichi kun waraana Gaazaa keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru akkasumas dhuunfannaa lafa Weest Baankii fi Kibba Liibaanoos mormuuf kan kaayyeffatedha. Meelenchoon naannolee kana eeguuf akkasumas hawaasa rakkoo keessa jiru gargaaruuf tarkaanfii qabatamaa fudhachuuf murteeffachuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: 'You lost war and election': Iran's Rezaei warns US of 'devastating response'
english: Major General Mohsen Rezaei, a high-ranking Iranian security official, has issued a stern warning to the United States regarding future military aggression. In a recent statement, he criticized the current state of the U.S. leadership and political landscape while threatening a severe military reaction if hostilities recommence. Rezaei emphasized that any attempt to start a new war would be met with a destructive counterattack from Iran.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ የጸጥታ ምክር ቤት ጸሐፊ ሜጀር ጀነራል ሞህሰን ረዛኢ በአሜሪካ ላይ አዲስ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ቢሰነዘር ጠንካራ ምላሽ እንደሚሰጡ አስጠንቅቀዋል። በአሜሪካ ወቅታዊ የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ላይ ትችታቸውን የሰነዘሩት ረዛኢ፣ ሀገሪቱ ጦርነት ከጀመረች ኢራን እጅግ አውዳሚ የሆነ አጸፋዊ ምላሽ እንደምትሰጥ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ማስጠንቀቂያ የተሰጠው አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የምታደርገውን ማንኛውንም አይነት የጦርነት ቅስቀሳ ለመከላከል ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan nageenyaa ol'aanaa Iiraan, Mejeer Jeneraal Mohsen Rezaa'ii, yoo Ameerikaan lola haaraa jalqabde tarkaanfii cimaa fi miidhaa geessisu akka fudhatan akeekkachiisaniiru. Hogganaan kun haala siyaasaa Ameerikaa keessa jiru qeequun, mootummaan Ameerikaa lola keessa seenee akka hin mufanneef jechuun ergaa cimaa dabarsaniiru. Iiraan lola kamiyyuu akka gaariitti of irraa ittisuuf qophiidha jechuun ibsaniiru.

title: Centcom sets up 'Task Force Iron Gate' to disrupt Iran’s weapons transfers
english: The U.S. Central Command has launched 'Task Force Iron Gate' to intercept Iranian weapons and sanctioned goods moving across land borders and the Caspian Sea. Based in Florida, this group of 20 personnel will work with other government agencies to cut off illicit funding and military supply chains. This initiative builds on existing maritime blockades to further restrict Iran's ability to support regional proxies and military expansion.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴንትኮም (Centcom) ኢራን በመሬት እና በካስፒያን ባህር በኩል የምታደርገውን የጦር መሳሪያና ህገ-ወጥ ቁሳቁስ ዝውውር ለመግታት 'ታስክ ፎርስ አይረን ጌት' የተሰኘ አዲስ ቡድን አቋቋመ። በፍሎሪዳ የሚገኘው ይህ የሃያ ባለሙያዎች ቡድን፣ ሌሎች የመንግስት ተቋማት ጋር በመተባበር የኢራንን የገንዘብ እና የጦር መሳሪያ አቅርቦት ለማቋረጥ ይሰራል። ይህ እርምጃ ቀደም ሲል በባህር ላይ ሲደረግ የነበረውን እገዳ በማጠናከር የኢራንን ወታደራዊ አቅም የመገደብ ዓላማ አለው።
oromo: Ajajni giddugaleessa Ameerikaa (Centcom) meeshaalee waraanaa fi meeshaalee dhorkaman daangaa lafaa fi galaana Kaspian irraan dabarsuu Iran ittisuuf 'Task Force Iron Gate' kan jedhamu garee haaraa hundeessuu isaa beeksisera. Gareen kun qondaaltoota 20 of keessatti qabatuun, kan hundaa'e Florida keessatti yoo ta'u, dhaabbilee mootummaa biroo wajjin ta'uun gargaarsa mallaqaa fi dhiyeessii waraanaa Iran itti fufiinsaan ittisuuf hojjata. Hojiin kun, ittisa galaana irraatiin booda, dandeettii Iran kan waraanaa fi kan maallaqaa daangessuuf gumaacha guddaa qaba.

title: Yemen and Lebanon to work towards halting Hezbollah support for Houthis, minister says
english: Yemen's foreign minister announced plans to work with Lebanese officials to stop Hezbollah from assisting Houthi military operations. Both countries aim to improve cooperation to ensure national sovereignty and security while preventing foreign interference in their internal affairs. This diplomatic effort seeks to strengthen ties between the two nations through mutual respect and shared regional stability goals.
amharic: የየመን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ሄዝቦላህ ለሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የሚያደርገውን ድጋፍ ለማስቆም ከሊባኖስ ባለስልጣናት ጋር በጋራ ለመስራት መስማማታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ሁለቱ ሀገራት የየራሳቸውን ሉዓላዊነት እና ደህንነት ለማስጠበቅ እንዲሁም የውጭ ጣልቃ ገብነትን ለመከላከል የቅርብ ትብብር ለማድረግ አቅደዋል። ይህ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ግንኙነት በማጠናከር ቀጣናዊ ሰላምን ለማምጣት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri dhimma alaa Yaman, gareen Hizbollah gocha waraana Hutiif deeggarsa akka hin goone dhaabsisuuf mootummaa Libaanoos waliin hojjechuuf walii galuu isaanii ibsan. Biyyoonni lameen kun kabaja fi nageenya biyyoolessaa isaanii eeggachuu akkasumas giddugalummaa alaa ittisuuf waliin hojjechuuf karoorfataniiru. Carraaqqiin diippilomaasii kun walitti dhufeenya biyyoota lameenii cimsuudhaan nagaa naannichaa mirkaneessuuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: Death toll from air strikes near Yemeni capital rises to 33, Houthis say
english: Air strikes on a village near Sanaa, Yemen, have resulted in at least 33 deaths and 39 injuries, according to Houthi officials. The attacks hit residential homes and reportedly killed mostly women and children. Rescue operations have been hindered because the area continues to be targeted, resulting in casualties even among medical personnel.
amharic: የሁቲ ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት በየመን ዋና ከተማ ሰንዓ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ መንደር በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ 33 ሰዎች መሞታቸውንና 39 መቁሰላቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ጥቃቱ የመኖሪያ ቤቶችን ኢላማ ያደረገ ሲሆን በአብዛኛው ሴቶችና ህጻናት ለህልፈት ተዳርገዋል። አካባቢው ላይ ጥቃቱ ተደጋግሞ በመፈጸሙ የነፍስ አድን ስራዎች የተስተጓጎሉ ሲሆን የህክምና ባለሙያዎችም ጭምር በግጭቱ ተጎድተዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Huutii akka ibsanitti, magaalaa guddoo Yaman Sana’aa biratti miidhagaalee bakka buufatameen namoonni 33 lubbuun darbanii 39 immoo madaa’aniiru. Haleellaan kun manneen jireenyaa kan rukute yoo ta’u, miidhamtoota keessaa baay’een isaanii dubartoota fi ijoollee dha. Haleellaan kun itti fufuun isaa hojii gargaarsa hatattamaa danqee, ogeeyyiin fayyaa illee miidhaa irra ga’eera.

title: Israel's president tasks opposition leader Eisenkot with forming government
english: Israeli President Isaac Herzog has officially asked opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot to form a new government following the recent inconclusive election results. Although no single party secured a majority, Eisenkot received more parliamentary recommendations than incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Eisenkot now has four weeks to build a governing coalition, a difficult task given the fragmented nature of the Israeli parliament.
amharic: የእስራኤል ፕሬዚዳንት ይስሐቅ ሄርዞግ በቅርቡ በተካሄደው ምርጫ አሸናፊ ባለመኖሩ ምክንያት የተቃዋሚው መሪ ጋዲ አይዘንኮት አዲስ መንግስት እንዲመሰርቱ ስልጣን ሰጥተዋል። ምንም እንኳን የትኛውም ፓርቲ አብላጫ ድምፅ ባያገኝም፣ አይዘንኮት ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በበለጠ የተመራጮች ድጋፍ አግኝተዋል። በዚህም መሰረት አይዘንኮት የተበታተነውን የፓርላማ ድርድር በማስተባበር ጥምር መንግስት ለመመስረት የ28 ቀናት ጊዜ ተሰጥቷቸዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Israa'el Isaak Herzoog bu'aan filannoo waan hin iftoomneef, gaggeessaan mormituu Gaadii Aayizenkoot mootummaa haaraa akka hundeessan gaafataniiru. Paartiin tokko illee sagalee caalmaa waan hin arganneef, Aayizenkoot muummicha ministeeraa kan ta'an Beenjaamiin Nataanyaahuurra deeggarsa baay'ee argataniiru. Aayizenkoot amma paartilee siyaasaa walii galchuun mootummaa hundeessuuf guyyoota 28 qabu.

title: Real Madrid beat Valencia 3-0 to draw level with La Liga leaders Barcelona
english: Real Madrid secured a dominant 3-0 victory over Valencia, with goals from Federico Valverde, Arda Guler, and Kylian Mbappé. This win marks the team's eighth consecutive victory, allowing them to temporarily match Barcelona's point total at the top of the La Liga table. Mbappé continued his impressive form by scoring in his seventh straight match to seal the win.
amharic: ሪያል ማድሪድ ቫሌንሺያን 3 ለ 0 በማሸነፍ በላሊጋው አናት ላይ ካለው ባርሴሎና ጋር ነጥብ ተጋርተዋል። የድል ግቦቹን ፈዴሪኮ ቫልቬርዴ፣ አርዳ ጉለር እና ኪሊያን ምባፔ ያስቆጠሩ ሲሆን፣ ቡድኑ በሁሉም ውድድሮች ያለውን ተከታታይ የድል ጉዞ ወደ ስምንት ከፍ አድርጓል። ምባፔም በተከታታይ በሰባተኛው ጨዋታ ግብ በማስቆጠር ጥሩ ብቃቱን አሳይቷል።
oromo: Real Madrid tapha Valencia irratti 3-0 injifachuun, qabxii isaa La Liga irratti Barcelona wajjin qixxeessera. Galchoota kunneen Federico Valverde, Arda Guler fi Kylian Mbappe kan galchanii yoo ta'u, kunis taphataan kun dorgommiiwwan hunda irratti walitti aansuun injifannoo saddeettaffaa akka galmeessu isa taasiseera. Mbappe tapha torba walitti aansuun galchuu danda'uun qormaata guddaa agarsiiseera.

title: Police clash with protesters as anti-government rallies sweep France
english: Protesters known as the Yellow Vests engaged in confrontations with police in Paris after defying a ban on their demonstration. At least 146,000 people marched across France for the fourth consecutive week to voice their frustration over the rising cost of living. Authorities arrested two movement leaders as the rallies continued to sweep through the country.
amharic: የቢጫ ጃኬት ለባሾች የተባሉ ተቃዋሚዎች የተጣለባቸውን የሰልፍ እገዳ በመተላለፋቸው በፓሪስ ከፖሊስ ጋር ተጋጭተዋል። በፈረንሳይ ያሉ ቢያንስ 146,000 ሰዎች የኑሮ ውድነትን በመቃወም ለተከታታይ አራተኛ ሳምንት አደባባይ ወጥተዋል። በሰልፉ ወቅትም የተቃውሞ እንቅስቃሴውን ሲመሩ የነበሩ ሁለት ግለሰቦች በፖሊስ ቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል።
oromo: Hiriirtonni 'Yellow Vests' jedhaman dhowwii gocha hiriiraa cabsanii bahuun isaaniin, magaalaa Paariis keessatti poolisoota wajjin walitti bu'iinsi uumameera. Namoonni 146,000 ol ta'an gatiin jireenyaa dabaluu isaatiin mufatanii torban afurffaadhaaf guutuu Faransaay keessatti hiriira bahaniiru. Walitti bu'iinsa kana keessatti hoogganoonni hiriiraa lama poolisaan qabamaniiru.

title: Mélenchon promises action against Israeli annexation if elected President
english: French presidential candidate Jean-Luc Mélenchon has committed to taking a firm stance against Israeli policies in Palestinian territories if he wins the election. He specifically pledged to oppose the annexation of the West Bank and the ongoing conflict in Gaza. His campaign promises focus on providing stronger support for the Palestinian cause through direct government action.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ የፕሬዚዳንት እጩ ዣን-ሉክ ሜለንቾን ወደ ስልጣን ከመጡ በእስራኤል የፖሊሲ እርምጃዎች ላይ ጠንካራ አቋም እንደሚወስዱ ቃል ገብተዋል። በተለይም በዌስት ባንክ የሚደረገውን መሬት የመቀላቀል እንቅስቃሴ እና በጋዛ ያለውን ግጭት እንደሚቃወሙ አስታውቀዋል። የዘመቻው ዋና ትኩረትም በፍልስጤማውያን ጉዳይ ላይ ተጨባጭ የመንግስት ድጋፍ ማድረግ ነው።
oromo: Kaadhimamaan pirezidaantummaa Faransaay Zhaan-Luuk Meelenchoon, yoo filataman imaammata Israa'eel kanneen naannoo Falasxiin irratti fudhataman mormuuf waadaa galaniiru. Keessattuu, qabiyyee lafa Gadaa Lixaa fi waraana Gaazaa keessatti adeemsifamaa jiru mormuuf dhaadataniiru. Kaayyoon isaanii inni guddaan gocha mootummaan Falasxiinotaaf deeggarsa qabatamaa taasisuu dha.

title: Who is behind Europe’s suspected hybrid attacks?
english: European nations are facing a surge of disruptive hybrid attacks, including false bomb threats that have paralyzed airports and cyberattacks targeting supermarket cooling systems. These incidents have sparked widespread security concerns regarding the vulnerability of vital civilian infrastructure across the continent. Authorities are now investigating whether these separate acts are part of a coordinated campaign and are working to determine who is responsible.
amharic: የአውሮፓ አገራት በአየር ማረፊያዎች ላይ በሚደረጉ የሐሰት የቦምብ ማስፈራሪያዎችና በሱፐርማርኬቶች ላይ በሚቃጡ የሳይበር ጥቃቶች ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ስጋት ውስጥ ወድቀዋል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች የሲቪል መሠረተ ልማቶችን ደህንነት አደጋ ላይ ጥለዋል። ባለሥልጣናት እነዚህ ተከታታይ ጥቃቶች የተቀናጀ ዘመቻ መሆናቸውን እና ከዚህ በስተጀርባ ማን እንዳለ ለማወቅ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Biyyoonni Awurooppaa xiyyaaraafi suuqiiwwan gurguddaa irratti haleellaa suuraa garaagaraa kanneen akka sossobbiin boombii fi haleellaa saayibarii irratti gaggeeffamaa jiruun yaaddoo nageenyaa keessa galaniiru. Haleellaawwan kun bu'uuraalee misoomaa hawaasummaa biyyattii miidhaa jiru. Qondaalonni mootummaa haleellaawwan kunneen walitti hidhata qabaachuu fi namoota kana duuba jiran adda baasuuf qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Abdul El-Sayed slams Trump’s tariff war with Canada
english: Newly elected Michigan Senator Abdul El-Sayed has publicly criticized Donald Trump's tariff policies regarding Canada. He argued that these trade barriers ultimately harm American consumers by driving up the prices of Canadian products. El-Sayed shared these concerns during a recent appearance on the Pod Save America podcast.
amharic: አዲስ የተመረጡት የሚቺጋን ሴናተር አብዱል ኤል-ሳዬድ በካናዳ ላይ የተጣለውን የዶናልድ ትራምፕ የንግድ ታሪፍ ተቃውመዋል። እነዚህ የንግድ ገደቦች የካናዳ ምርቶች ዋጋ እንዲጨምሩ በማድረግ በመጨረሻ የአሜሪካ ሸማቾችን እንደሚጎዱ ገልጸዋል። ሴናተሩ ይህንን ሃሳብ የገለጹት በቅርቡ በፖድ ሴቭ አሜሪካ ፖድካስት ላይ በነበራቸው ቆይታ ነው።
oromo: Senatorichi Michigan haaraa filataman Abdul El-Sayed, imaammata taarifa daldalaa Donald Trump kan biyya Kaanaadaa irratti qaban mormaniiru. Taarifiin kun gatii meeshaalee Kaanaadaa ol kaasuun walumaagalatti gabaastota Ameerikaa miidha jiru jedhaniiru. El-Sayed yaada kana kan ibsan sagantaa 'Pod Save America' jedhamu irratti dhihaatanii dha.

title: US military says it disabled cargo vessel in Gulf of Oman
english: The US military used precision fire to disable a cargo ship after it attempted to bypass a naval blockade following a visit to an Iranian port. In a broader effort to enforce sanctions, the US is also establishing a new task force to intercept illegal arms shipments across Iran's land and sea borders. Officials estimate that these ongoing blockade efforts have successfully blocked Iran from exporting over $25 billion in crude oil.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል ኢራንን የወደብ ጉብኝት አድርጎ የባህር ማገጃውን ለመጣስ የሞከረ የጭነት መርከብ ላይ ጥቃት በመሰንዘር እንዲቆም አድርጓል። አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የጣለችውን ማዕቀብ ለማስፈጸም የጦር መሳሪያ ዝውውርን ለመቆጣጠር የሚያስችል አዲስ ግብረ ኃይል አቋቁማለች። እስከ አሁን ባለው የባህር ማገጃ ስራ ኢራን ከ25 ቢሊዮን ዶላር በላይ የሚገመት ድፍድፍ ነዳጅ ወደ ውጭ እንዳትልክ መከላከል መቻሉን የአሜሪካ የጦር መምሪያ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Waraanni Ameerikaa markabii fe'umsaa buufata Iran dhaqee deebi'uun dhoorka galaanaa inni kaa'e cabsuuf yaalii goote rukutuun akka dhaabatu godheera. Ameerikaan tarkaanfii kanaan cinaatti, gurgurtaa meeshaalee waraanaa seeraan alaa fi sanadaalee dhoorkaman to'achuuf garee addaa haarawa ijaaruu ishee beeksisite. Hojiin dhoorka galaanaa kun hanga ammaatti Iran boba'aa dachaasaa gatiin isaa biliyoona 25 doolaraa ol ta'u gurguruu akka hin dandeenye taasiseera.

title: Iran's army says forces 'stronger' than at start of war, Hormuz to stay closed
english: The Iranian military claims it is more powerful and prepared than at the start of the current conflict, vowing to keep the Strait of Hormuz closed until its demands are satisfied. Officials have signaled their intent to defend national sovereignty with increased missile capabilities while engaging in diplomatic outreach across the region. Meanwhile, the United States is pushing to curb Iran's nuclear development by offering financial rewards for information related to the country's nuclear program.
amharic: የኢራን ወታደራዊ አመራሮች አገራቸው አሁን ከጀመረው ጦርነት መጀመሪያ ይልቅ በጠንካራ አቋም ላይ እንደምትገኝ በመግለጽ፣ የሆርሙዝ የባህር በር ፍላጎታቸው እስኪሟላ ድረስ ተዘግቶ እንደሚቆይ አስታውቀዋል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት የአገራቸውን ሉዓላዊነት ለመከላከል ሚሳኤሎቻቸውን እያሳደጉ መሆናቸውን የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድም ከአካባቢው አገራት ጋር ውይይት እያደረጉ ነው። በሌላ በኩል፣ አሜሪካ የኢራንን የኑክሌር ፕሮግራም ለመግታት መረጃ ለሚሰጡ ሰዎች የገንዘብ ሽልማት በመስጠት ጥረቷን አጠናክራ ቀጥላለች።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Iraan waraana kana keessatti amma irra caalaa humna cimaa fi qophii ta'uu ishee ibsuun, hanga gaaffiin isaanii guututti daandiin galaana Hormuz cufaa akka ta'u beeksisan. Mootummaan Iraan of ittisuuf meeshaalee waraanaa fi misayiloota ishee jabeeffachaa jiru, gama biraatiin immoo biyyoota ollaa waliin marii diplomaasii taasisuu itti fufaniiru. Gamasaatiin, mootummaan Ameerikaa sagantaa niwukilaraa Iraan daangessuuf, odeeffannoo kennaniif badhaasa maallaqaa qopheessuun ishee beekameera.

title: Explosions reported on Iran's Qeshm Island and in port of Jask
english: Local media reported explosions in Iran's Qeshm Island and the port of Jask on Saturday, though authorities have not yet confirmed the cause. While one agency mentioned the possibility of missile strikes, no group has claimed responsibility for the incident. These reports follow recent limited military actions conducted by the United States in the region.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ዕለት በኢራን የቀሽም ደሴት እና የጃስክ ወደብ አካባቢ ፍንዳታዎች እንደተሰሙ የአካባቢው መገናኛ ብዙኃን ዘግበዋል። ምንም እንኳን አንዳንድ ምንጮች ሚሳኤሎች ተተኩሰው ሊሆን እንደሚችል ቢገልጹም፣ መንግሥት እስካሁን ስለ ፍንዳታው ምክንያቶች ይፋዊ ማብራሪያ አልሰጠም። ይህ ክስተት የተከሰተው አሜሪካ በክልሉ ውስጥ ውስን ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎችን ከወሰደች ከጥቂት ቀናት በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Dilbata darbe gabaasawwan miidiyaaleen akka ibsanitti, qarqara galaana Iran kan ta'e ganda Qeshm fi buufata Jask keessatti dhukaatin dhagahameera. Haa ta'u malee, sababa dhukaatii kanaa irratti mootummaan Iran hanga ammaatti ifatti waan ibse hin jiru. Gabaasni kun kan dhufu, qilleensarraa tarkaanfiin muraasni Ameerikaan naannichatti erga raawwattee guyyoota muraasa booda.

title: Saudi Arabia lifts alert in Jazan, home to Aramco refinery targeted by Houthis
english: Saudi authorities have removed a safety alert in the Jazan region following concerns over potential security threats. This area is strategically significant as it houses a major Aramco oil refinery. The region has frequently faced drone and missile strikes from Houthi rebels due to its proximity to the ongoing conflict in Yemen.
amharic: የሳዑዲ አረቢያ የሲቪል መከላከያ ባለስልጣናት በጃዛን ግዛት ላይ ጥለውት የነበረውን የደህንነት ማስጠንቀቂያ አንስተዋል። አካባቢው ትልቅ የአራምኮ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ የሚገኝበት በመሆኑ ወሳኝ ቦታ ነው። በየመን ያለው ግጭት ከተቀሰቀሰበት ጊዜ ጀምሮ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በዚሁ ክልል በሚገኙ የኢነርጂ መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ ተደጋጋሚ የድሮን እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃቶችን ሲሰነዝሩ ቆይተዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Saudii Arabaa ergaa akeekkachiisaa naannoo Jazanirratti labsame ture erga tasgabbii booda kaaseera. Naannichi qabeenya gurguddaa kanneen akka iddoo daaddoo boba'aa Aramkoo waan of keessaa qabuuf bakka hambaalee sodaachisaa turee dha. Naannichi daangaa Yamanitti dhiyoo waan ta'eef, waraana Yaman keessatti geggeeffamuun walqabatee gareen Huutii dronii fi misayilootaan yeroo garagaraa haleelaa ture.

title: Israel's president picks Eisenkot over Netanyahu to try to form new government
english: Israeli President Isaac Herzog has officially tasked opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot with forming a new government following the recent inconclusive national election. Although Benjamin Netanyahu’s right-wing bloc holds the most individual seats, Eisenkot secured broader support from Arab-led parties during consultations, giving him a potential parliamentary majority. Eisenkot now has 28 days to negotiate a coalition, a process complicated by his refusal to form a formal alliance with Arab factions despite their essential backing.
amharic: የእስራኤል ፕሬዚዳንት አይዛክ ሄርዞግ በቅርቡ በተካሄደው አወዛጋቢ ምርጫ ምክንያት አዲስ መንግስት የመመስረት ስልጣንን ለተቃዋሚው መሪ ጋዲ አይዘንኮት ሰጥተዋል። ምንም እንኳን የቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ፓርቲ በአብላጫ መቀመጫዎች ቢመራም፣ አይዘንኮት ከአረብ ወገን ካሉ ፓርቲዎች ድጋፍ በማግኘቱ መንግስት የመመስረት እድል አግኝቷል። አይዘንኮት ጥምር መንግስት ለመመስረት የ28 ቀናት ጊዜ የተሰጠው ሲሆን፣ ከአረብ ፓርቲዎች ጋር ህጋዊ ጥምረት ለመፍጠር ፈቃደኛ አለመሆኑ ሂደቱን ፈታኝ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Pireezidaantii Israa'el Isaak Herzoog, filannoo booda mootummaa haaraa hundeessuuf goggeessa mormituu Gaadii Aayzenkootiif carraa kennaniiru. Injifannoon ifa ta'e waan hin argamneef, Binyaamin Netanyaanhuu teessoo baay'ee qabaatanis, Aayzenkoot paartilee Arabaatiin deggaramee caalmaa argachuu danda'eera. Aayzenkoot mootummaa kutaalee walitti makamoo ta'e hundeessuuf guyyaa 28 kan qabu yoo ta'u, paartilee Arabaa wajjin walta'iinsa seeraa uumuuf fedhii waan hin qabneef adeemsichi rakkisaa ta'uu danda'a.

title: What we know about Krakow mass shooting so far
english: A gunman in military gear opened fire on civilians in Krakow's Main Market Square, resulting in six deaths and at least 15 injuries. Police engaged the suspect in a shootout, eventually wounding and arresting him, though one officer remains in critical condition. Authorities have confirmed the shooter is a Polish citizen, but his motive for the attack is still under investigation.
amharic: በፖላንድ ክራኮው ከተማ ማዕከላዊ አደባባይ ላይ የታጠቀ ሰው በሰዎች ላይ በከፈተው ተኩስ ስድስት ሰዎች ሲገደሉ ቢያንስ 15 ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ፖሊስ ተጠርጣሪውን በተኩስ ልውውጥ ካቆሰለ በኋላ በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋለው ሲሆን፣ በድርጊቱ ወቅት አንድ የፖሊስ መኮንን በከባድ ሁኔታ ላይ ይገኛል። አጥቂው የፖላንድ ዜጋ መሆኑ ቢረጋገጥም፣ ጥቃቱን የፈጸመበት ምክንያት እስካሁን በውል አልታወቀም።
oromo: Magaalatti Poolaandi, Kraakoow keessatti namni meeshaa waraanaa hidhate tokko bakka namoonni baay'atanitti dhukaasa banuun lubbuun namoota jahaa darbeera, namoonni 15 ol immoo miidhamaniiru. Poolisiin nama shakkamaa kana wal-dhukaasa booda booji'uu danda'eera; ta'us, poolisiin tokko miidhaa cimaa irra gahee yaalamutti jira. Namichi kun lammii Poolaand ta'uun isaa mirkanaa'us, kaayyoon inni miidhaa kana geessiseef hanga ammatti hin beekamu.

title: US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme
english: The United States is offering a reward of up to $20 million for information regarding Iran's nuclear activities, including details about facilities, equipment, and staff. The U.S. government is also promising potential relocation for those who come forward with this intelligence. Additionally, the U.S. military has launched a new task force to better monitor and restrict the movement of illegal weapons and sanctioned materials linked to Iran.
amharic: አሜሪካ ስለ ኢራን የኑክሌር ፕሮግራም መረጃ ለሚሰጥ አካል እስከ 20 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የሚደርስ ሽልማት እንደምትሰጥ አስታውቃለች። መረጃ ሰጪው ለደህንነቱ ሲባል ወደ ሌላ ቦታ እንዲዛወርም ድጋፍ ሊደረግለት ይችላል። በተጨማሪም፣ አሜሪካ በኢራን በኩል የሚደረገውን የጦር መሳሪያና የታገዱ ቁሳቁሶች ዝውውር ለመቆጣጠር አዲስ ወታደራዊ ግብረ ኃይል አቋቁማለች።
oromo: Amerikaa waa'ee sagantaa niwukilaraa Iraan odeeffannoo kennuuf doolara miliyoona 20 ga'uuf badhaasa qopheessiteetti. Namni odeeffannoo kana dhiyeessu akkaataa fedhii isaatiin gara biroo bakka nagayaatti akka godaanuuf gargaarsi akka godhamuufis waadaa galameera. Kana malees, waraanni Amerikaa meeshaalee waraanaa fi meeshaalee dhorkaman Iraan irraa gara biyya alaa akka hin baane to'achuuf garee addaa haarawa tokko hundeesseera.

title: Houthis say at least 25 killed in Saudi air strike
english: Houthi-affiliated media in Yemen reported that a Saudi-led airstrike in the town of al-Shariyah killed at least 25 civilians, including women and children. This attack is part of an intensifying conflict between Houthi rebels and the Saudi-backed government, which has caused thousands of deaths and widespread displacement. While the Houthi leadership has promised retaliation, the Saudi-led coalition has not yet issued an official response to the incident.
amharic: በየመን የሁቲ አማፂያን ቡድን እንደገለፀው በሳዑዲ አረቢያ የሚመራው ጥምረት በአል-ሻሪያ ከተማ ባደረሰው የአየር ድብደባ ሴቶችን እና ህፃናትን ጨምሮ ቢያንስ 25 ንፁሃን ዜጎች ተገድለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት በሁቲ አማፂያን እና በሳዑዲ በሚደገፈው የየመን መንግስት መካከል እየተባባሰ ባለው ግጭት ውስጥ የተፈጠረ ሲሆን፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች እንዲሞቱና እንዲፈናቀሉ ምክንያት ሆኗል። የሁቲ መሪዎች ለጥቃቱ የበቀል እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ ቢያስታውቁም፣ የሳዑዲ ጥምረት በጉዳዩ ላይ እስካሁን የሰጠው አስተያየት የለም።
oromo: Mootummaan Houthii Yemen keessatti qilleensaan haleellaa Sa'udi Arabiyaan gaggeessiteen dubartoota fi daa'imman dabalatee namoonni 25 ol du'uu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Haleellaan kun waraana Houthii fi mootummaa Sa'udiin deeggaramu gidduutti walitti bu'iinsi uumamee jiru daran akka hammaatu taasiseera, kunis lubbuu namoota kumaatamaan lakkaawwaman akka bade fi qe'ee irra akka buqqa'an taasiseera. Hogganoonni Houthii deebii akka kennan waadaa seenanillee, gamtaan Sa'udiin durfamu hanga ammaatti ibsa kennuu dhiiseera.

title: UK cannot 'cherry pick' EU single market deal, Barnier tells BBC
english: Former EU Brexit negotiator Michel Barnier has warned that the UK cannot selectively choose which parts of the European single market to participate in. He emphasized that gaining market access requires full acceptance of all four EU freedoms, including the free movement of people. While the door remains open for the UK to pursue a closer relationship or even rejoin the bloc, there is no option to pick and choose specific rules.
amharic: የቀድሞው የአውሮፓ ህብረት የብሬክዚት ተደራዳሪ ሚሼል ባርኒየር፣ ዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የአውሮፓን የጋራ ገበያ ጥቅሞችን በፈለገችው መንገድ መምረጥ እንደማትችል አስጠንቅቀዋል። የጋራ ገበያውን ለመጠቀም የሰዎችን ነጻ ዝውውርን ጨምሮ ሁሉንም የአውሮፓ ህብረት ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች ሙሉ በሙሉ መቀበል እንደሚያስፈልግ ገልጸዋል። ዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ከህብረቱ ጋር ያላትን ግንኙነት ለማጥበቅ ወይም እንደገና ለመቀላቀል ፍላጎት ቢኖራትም፣ የፈለጉትን ህግ ብቻ መርጦ መውሰድ ግን እንደማይቻል አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni marii Brexit duraanii kan ta'an Michel Barnier, UK gabaa gamtaa Awurooppaa keessaa wantoota barbaadan qofa filachuu akka hin dandeenye akeekkachiisaniiru. Gabaa kana fayyadamuuf mirgoota afur kan Awurooppaa gamtaa keessatti argaman, keessattuu mirga namootaa bilisummaan socho'uu guutummaatti fudhachuu akka qaban ibsaniiru. UK hariiroo ishee Awurooppaa waliin cimsuuf ykn deebitee gamtichaatti makamuuf carraa qabaattus, seera barbaadan qofa filachaa deemun garuu kan hin danda'amne ta'uu hubachiisaniiru.

title: Latvian farmers protest over ‘blood grain’ trade with Russia
english: Latvian farmers have organized protests against the continued transit of Russian grain through their country. They argue that these trade activities essentially provide financial support for Russia's ongoing military actions in Ukraine. The demonstrators believe it is hypocritical for the nation to back Kyiv while simultaneously enabling the movement of Russian goods.
amharic: የላትቪያ አርሶ አደሮች በሀገራቸው በኩል የሩሲያ እህል እንዲያልፍ በመቃወም ተቃውሞ አሰምተዋል። እነዚህ የንግድ ልውውጦች የሩሲያ በዩክሬን ላይ እያደረሰች ያለውን ጦርነት በገንዘብ ለመደገፍ እንደሚረዱ ይናገራሉ። አርሶ አደሮቹ ሀገራቸው ኪየቭን እየደገፈች በሌላ በኩል የሩሲያ እህል እንዲንቀሳቀስ መፍቀዷ ተገቢ አይደለም ሲሉ ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Qonnaan bultonni biyya Laatviyaa, midhaan Raashiyaa biyyattiin darbuu mormanii hiriira ba'aniiru. Gochi kun waraana Raashiyaan Yukreen irratti gaggeessituuf deeggarsa maallaqaa akka ta'e qonnaan bultonni kun ibsu. Biyyi tokko gama tokkoon Yukreen deeggartu gama biraan immoo midhaan Raashiyaa akka darbu hayyamuun ishee sirrii miti jechuun mormiisaa jiru.

title: Yemeni gov’t forces report advances as Houthis say deadly strikes hit Sanaa
english: Yemeni government forces claim to have made significant military gains against Houthi fighters in the Marib and al-Jawf provinces as part of a month-long offensive. Meanwhile, Houthi officials reported that air strikes in a village near Sanaa resulted in at least 27 deaths, primarily involving women and children. The Houthis have pledged to retaliate for these casualties, which they attribute to the Saudi-led coalition, further escalating the ongoing conflict.
amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ኃይሎች ባለፉት አንድ ወር በጀመሩት ዘመቻ በማሪብ እና በአል-ጃውፍ ግዛቶች በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ ድል ማስመዝገባቸውን አስታውቀዋል። በተመሳሳይ ወቅት፣ ከሰንዓ ከተማ አቅራቢያ በምትገኝ መንደር በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ 27 ሰዎች መገደላቸውን ሁቲዎች ገልጸዋል፤ ከሟቾች መካከል አብዛኛዎቹ ሴቶችና ህጻናት ናቸው። ሁቲዎች ለደረሰው ጉዳት የሳዑዲ ጥምረት ኃይሎችን በመክሰስ የበቀል እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ ዛተዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni mootummaa Yaman duula ji'a tokko guutuu gaggeessaa jiraniin, naannolee Marib fi Al-Jawf keessatti garee Huutii irratti injifannoo argachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Gama biraatiin, qondaalonni Huutii magaalaa San'aa cinaatti iddoo tokkotti haleellaa xiyyaaraan raawwatameen namoonni 27 du'uu fi baay'een isaanii dubartoota fi daa'imman ta'uu beeksisaniiru. Gareen Huutii haleellaa kanaaf kutaalee waraana Sa'udii qindeessitu itti gaafatamaa gochuun, deebii akka kennan waadaa galaniiru.

title: Demonstration in Berlin calls for an end to arming Israel
english: Hundreds of protesters gathered in Berlin to demand an end to the conflict in the Middle East. The participants specifically urged the German government to stop supplying weapons to Israel. Additionally, the group called for the release of Palestinian prisoners while marking the anniversary of the Balfour Declaration.
amharic: በበርሊን በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰልፈኞች በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው ግጭት እንዲቆም ጠየቁ። ተሳታፊዎቹ በተለይም የጀርመን መንግስት ለእስራኤል የጦር መሳሪያ ማቅረቡን እንዲያቆም አሳስበዋል። ሰልፈኞቹ የባልፎር መግለጫ መታሰቢያ ቀንን ምክንያት በማድረግ የፍልስጤም እስረኞች እንዲለቀቁም ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Hiriirtonni dhibbaan lakka'aman Barlinitti walgahanii waraanni giddu galeessa bahaatti godhamaa jiru akka dhaabatu gaafataniiru. Hiriirtonni kun mootummaan Jarman meeshaalee waraanaa Israa'eliif ergu akka dhaabu dhaamaniiru. Kana malees, guyyaa yaadannoo Balfour Declaration sababeeffachuun, hidhamtoonni Falasxiin akka gadhiifaman gaafataniiru.

title: Houston mayor orders police to limit cooperation with ICE
english: Houston Mayor John Whitmire has changed city policy by restricting police collaboration with federal immigration authorities. Moving forward, officers are only permitted to involve ICE when an individual arrested for a serious crime also has a specific administrative immigration warrant. This directive marks a significant shift in how the city manages its relationship with immigration enforcement.
amharic: የሂዩስተን ከንቲባ ጆን ዊትማየር የከተማዋ ፖሊስ ከፌዴራል የኢሚግሬሽን ባለስልጣናት ጋር ያላቸውን ግንኙነት እንዲገድብ ትዕዛዝ ሰጥተዋል። ከዚህ በኋላ ፖሊሶች ከኢሚግሬሽን ጋር የሚተባበሩት በቁጥጥር ስር የዋለ ሰው ከባድ ወንጀል ፈጽሞ ከተገኘ እና ተያያዥ የኢሚግሬሽን ማዘዣ ካለበት ብቻ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ ከተማዋ ከኢሚግሬሽን ማስፈጸሚያ አካላት ጋር የምትሰራበትን መንገድ ትልቅ ለውጥ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Magaalaa Hiyustonitti kan ta'an kantiibaan John Whitmire poolisiin magaalaa sun hojii irratti dhaabbata immigreeshinii federaalaa wajjin qaban akka murteessan ajajaniiru. Amma booda, poolisoonni ajaja immigreeshinii wajjin kan hojjatan namni yakka cimaan to'annoo jala oole tokko ajaja immigreeshinii addaa yoo qabaate qofadha. Murtuun kun magaalaan tun qaamota immigreeshinii wajjin hariiroo qabdu irratti jijjiirama guddaa fida.

title: Paraguay’s ousted president charged over banking scandal
english: Former Paraguayan President Santiago Pena has been charged with breach of trust and corruption following his impeachment over a major banking collapse. Authorities allege that Pena misused his political influence to funnel massive public funds into Ueno Bank, which eventually failed and left millions of citizens unable to access their money. While Pena maintains his innocence and claims the situation was purely regulatory, he is now under house arrest as public protests continue across the country.
amharic: የፓራጓይ የቀድሞ ፕሬዝዳንት ሳንቲያጎ ፔና በባንክ ቅሌት ሳቢያ ከስልጣን ከተወገዱ በኋላ በሙስና እና በእምነት ማጉደል ወንጀል ተከሰሱ። ፔና ስልጣናቸውን ተጠቅመው ከፍተኛ የመንግስት ገንዘብ ወደ ኡኤኖ ባንክ እንዲገባ በማድረጋቸው፣ ባንኩ በመክሰሩ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ዜጎች ገንዘባቸውን እንዳያገኙ ሆኗል። የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ክሱን ቢክዱም፣ አሁን በቁም እስር ላይ የሚገኙ ሲሆን በሀገሪቱ ተቃውሞዎች ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Paaraaguwaay kan duraanii Saantiyaagoo Peenaa, kisaaraa baankii gurguddaa waliin walqabatee himannaan yakka amanamummaa gurguddisuu fi malaammaltummaa irratti banameera. Peenaan aangoo isaanii fayyadamanii maallaqa mootummaa hedduu gara baankii 'Ueno' jedhamuutti akka darbu gochuu fi baankiin sun yeroo cufu lammiileen miiliyoonatti lakkaa'aman maallaqa isaanii dhabuun isaanii himatameera. Pirezidaantichi himannaa irratti dhihaate kana haaluus, amma mana isaaniitti hidhamanii (house arrest) kan jiran yoo ta'u, biyyattii keessatti mormiin uummataa itti fufee jira.

title: No clear winner after tight New Zealand general election
english: New Zealand's recent general election concluded without a definitive winner, leaving the major parties to begin negotiations to form a coalition government. While the center-right National Party secured the most seats, they fell short of a majority and must rely on potential partners to gain control. Both Prime Minister Christopher Luxon and opposition leader Chris Hipkins acknowledged that the final outcome remains uncertain until official results are released in late November.
amharic: በቅርቡ በኒውዚላንድ የተካሄደው አጠቃላይ ምርጫ አሸናፊ ሳይለይ በመጠናቀቁ፣ ዋና ዋና የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች ጥምር መንግስት ለመመስረት ድርድር ጀምረዋል። ምንም እንኳን የሴንተር-ራይት ናሽናል ፓርቲ ብዙ መቀመጫዎችን ቢያሸንፍም፣ መንግስት ለመመስረት የሚያስፈልገውን አብላጫ ድምፅ ማግኘት ስላልቻለ ከሌሎች አጋር ፓርቲዎች ጋር መስራት ይጠበቅበታል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ክሪስቶፈር ሉክሰን እና የተቃዋሚው መሪ ክሪስ ሂፕኪንስ፣ የመጨረሻው ውጤት በህዳር ወር መጨረሻ እስኪገለጽ ድረስ የመንግስት ምስረታው እርግጠኛ አለመሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Filannoon biyyaalessaa kan Niwuu Ziilaand dhiheenya kana gaggeeffame injifannoo ifa ta'e tokko malee waan xumurameef, paartileen gurguddoo mootummaa kutaalee (coalition) ijaaruuf marii jalqabaniiru. Paartiin giddu-galeessa mirgaa kan ta'e 'National Party' teessoo hedduu kan argate ta'us, mootummaa ijaaruuf sagalee gahaa waan hin arganneef, humnoota biroo waliin walii galuun dirqama ta'eera. Muummichi ministeeraa Kristofer Luukson fi hogganaan mormituu Kris Hipkiins, bu'aan xumuraa hanga dhuma ji'a Sadaasaatti hin beekamu waan ta'eef, gara fuulduraatti mootummaan akkamitti akka hundaa'u ammaaf ifa miti.

title: With Stephen Miller pick, Trump readies for a battle
english: Following the Republican Party's midterm election losses, Donald Trump has appointed his long-time advisor Stephen Miller as the new White House chief of staff. This move suggests that Trump intends to pursue a more aggressive political strategy rather than seeking compromise with the Democrats. Miller is well-known for his hardline stance on immigration and his history as a loyal, confrontational figure within Trump's inner circle.
amharic: የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ በመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ከተሸነፈ በኋላ፣ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የረጅም ጊዜ አማካሪያቸውን ስቲቨን ሚለርን አዲሱ የኋይት ሀውስ የሰራተኞች አለቃ አድርገው ሾመዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ትራምፕ ከዴሞክራቶች ጋር ከመደራደር ይልቅ ጠንካራ የፖለቲካ ፍጥጫ ውስጥ ለመግባት እንዳቀዱ ያሳያል። ሚለር በስደት እና በኢሚግሬሽን ጉዳዮች ላይ ባላቸው ጠንካራ አቋም እንዲሁም በትራምፕ አቅራቢያ እንደ ታማኝ እና ተከራካሪ ሰው በመታወቃቸው ይታወቃሉ።
oromo: Paartiin Rippabliikanii filannoo gidduu waggaa erga injifatamee booda, Donald Traamp gorsaa isaanii kan turan Stiiven Miiler itti aanaa qulqulluu hojjettoota mana White House godhatanii muudaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun Traamp diimookraatonni waliin marii gochuurra, siyaasa gadi jabeeffatanii ittifufuu akka barbaadan kan agarsiisuudha. Miiler seera godaantotaa irratti yaada cimaa qabachuu fi naannoo Traampitti nama amanamoo ta'anii fi falmii cimaa godhan keessaa tokko ta'uun isaanii ni beekama.

title: Russian strikes wound nine and damage Ukraine's power network ahead of talks
english: Russia launched a massive wave of drone and missile strikes across twelve Ukrainian regions, damaging critical energy infrastructure and causing widespread power and water outages. The attacks resulted in nine injuries, including a child, and struck various civilian targets such as a kindergarten and residential areas. These military actions occurred just before scheduled diplomatic talks between the two nations in Abu Dhabi, which President Zelensky described as a deliberate move by Moscow to undermine negotiations.
amharic: ሩሲያ በዩክሬን አሥራ ሁለት ክልሎች ላይ ባደረሰችው መጠነ ሰፊ የድሮን እና ሚሳይል ጥቃት የኤሌክትሪክ እና የውኃ መሠረተ ልማቶች ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በጥቃቱ ምክንያት ዘጠኝ ሰዎች መቁሰላቸው የተዘገበ ሲሆን፤ የትምህርት ቤት እና የመኖሪያ ቤቶችም ተጎድተዋል። ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ እንዳሉት ይህ ጥቃት በቅርቡ በአቡ ዳቢ ሊካሄድ የታቀደውን የሰላም ድርድር ለማደናቀፍ የታለመ የሩሲያ ሴራ ነው።
oromo: Raashiyaan naannolee 12 Yuukreyn keessatti duula diroonii fi misaayilaa cimaa gaggeessiteen bu'uuraalee misoomaa ibsaa fi bishaanii irratti miidhaan guddaan ga'eera. Miidhaa kanaan daa'ima tokko dabalatee namoonni sagal madaa'anii, manneen barnootaa fi bakkeewwan jireenyaa miidhamaniiru. Preezidaant Zeleniskiin gochi kun marii nageenyaa dhufu torbanitti Abu Daabii keessatti gaggeeffamuuf karoorfame laaffisuuf Raashiyaan kan raawwatamte ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: The Lions by the River Tigris: Restoring Mosul’s artefacts
english: A documentary titled The Lions by the River Tigris explores the efforts to preserve historical heritage in Mosul following its liberation from ISIL. The story follows three men as they debate the value of protecting ancient artifacts while acknowledging the deep human suffering caused by the war. Through their experiences, the film highlights the resilience of a city working to reclaim its 8,000-year history amidst the ruins.
amharic: የአንበሶቹ በጤግሮስ ወንዝ ዳርቻ የተሰኘው ዘጋቢ ፊልም፣ ከኢስላማዊ መንግስት ነፃ ከወጣች በኋላ በሞሱል የሚገኙ ጥንታዊ ቅርሶችን ለመታደግ የሚደረገውን ጥረት ይዳስሳል። ፊልሙ ሶስት ግለሰቦች የጥንት ቅርሶችን የመጠበቅን አስፈላጊነት ሲያወያዩ እና በጦርነቱ የደረሰውን የሰው ልጅ ስቃይ ሲመለከቱ ያሳያል። በዚህ ሂደትም፣ ከተማዋ የ8,000 ዓመታት ታሪኳን መልሳ ለመገንባት የምታደርገውን ጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Fiilmiin 'The Lions by the River Tigris' jedhamu, biyyattii Mosul ISIL jalaa erga bilisoomtee booda, meeshaalee aadaa fi seenaa qabeeyyii ta'an eeguuf carraaqqii godhamu kan ibsu dha. Seenaan kun namoota sadii irratti kan xiyyeeffatu yoo ta'u, isaanis seenaa bara dheeraa qabu kunuunsuu fi miidhaa namoota irratti gahe walbira qabuun irratti mari'atu. Fiilmichi, magaalaan Mosul seenaa waggaa 8,000 qabdu deebisanii ijaaruuf cimaa akka jirtu agarsiisa.

title: Iraq’s FM says external parties using Iraqi soil to attack neighbours
english: Iraqi Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein stated that unauthorized groups are using Iraqi territory to conduct attacks against neighboring countries, including Saudi Arabia. To address this, the government is working to bring armed factions under state control through peaceful negotiations rather than military force. Additionally, Iraq is coordinating with international partners to manage regional security, address interference, and ensure the stability of oil exports.
amharic: የኢራቅ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ፋኡድ ሁሴን አንዳንድ አካላት የኢራቅን መሬት ተጠቅመው በጎረቤት ሀገራት ላይ ጥቃት እየፈጸሙ መሆናቸውን ገለጹ። መንግስት እነዚህን ታጣቂ ቡድኖች በሀይል ከመጠቀም ይልቅ በውይይት ወደ ስርአት ለማስገባት ጥረት እያደረገ ነው። በተጨማሪም ኢራቅ ከኢራን የሚደረገውን ጣልቃገብነት በመቃወም የሀገሪቱን ደህንነት እና የነዳጅ ንግድ እንቅስቃሴ ለማረጋጋት እየሰራች ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Iraaq Fu'aad Huseen, gareewwan alaa biyya isaanii fayyadamanii biyyoota ollaa irratti haleellaa geggeessaa akka jiran ibsaniiru. Mootummaan Iraaq gareewwan hidhattoota kana humnaan utuu hin taane, mariidhaan toannoo mootummaa jala oolchuuf tattaaffachaa jira. Kana malees, Iraaq giddu-galummaa alaa balaaleffachuun nageenya biyyaa fi dhangala'aa boba'aa tasgabbeessuuf hojjechaa jirti.

title: New Zealand’s prime minister says election is ‘too close to call’
english: New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon has described the current election as extremely competitive and too close to determine a winner yet. While his National Party is currently showing a slight lead over the Labour Party in early vote counts, the final outcome remains uncertain. Luxon maintains that he still sees a viable strategy to establish the country's next administration.
amharic: የኒውዚላንድ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ክሪስቶፈር ሉክሰን አሁን እየተካሄደ ያለው ምርጫ እጅግ ተፎካካሪ በመሆኑ አሸናፊውን ለመለየት አስቸጋሪ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ምንም እንኳን የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ውጤቶች የብሔራዊ ፓርቲያቸው ከሌበር ፓርቲ በትንሽ ድምፅ እንደሚበልጥ ቢያሳዩም፣ የመጨረሻው ውጤት እስካሁን እርግጠኛ አይደለም። ሉክሰን ቀጣዩን መንግስት ለመመስረት የሚያስችል አማራጭ መንገድ እንዳላቸው አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa Niwuu Ziilaand Kiristoofar Luksaniin, filannoon amma adeemsifamaa jiru baay'ee wal-dorgomsiisaa waan ta'eef eenyutu akka mo'atu adda baasuun ulfaataa akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Bu'aan jalqabaa akka agarsiisutti paartiin isaanii 'Naashinal Paartii' paartii 'Leybariin' irraa qophiidhaan xiqqoo dursaa kan jiru ta'us, bu'aan xumuraa garuu ammayyuu murtaa'uu hin dandeenye. Luksaniin mootummaa itti aanu hundeesuuf carraan isaanii har'as akka jiru ibsaniiru.

title: Who is Hakeem Jeffries, the Democrat poised to become House speaker?
english: Following the Democratic victory in the midterm elections, Hakeem Jeffries is set to become the first Black Speaker of the US House of Representatives. While he holds a significant position of influence for the remainder of Donald Trump's term, his leadership is facing internal pushback. Many progressive party members are questioning his candidacy, citing concerns over his moderate political style and his long-standing support for Israel.
amharic: በአሜሪካ መካከለኛ የምርጫ ውጤት መሰረት የዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ አሸናፊ በመሆኑ ሀኪም ጄፍሪስ የመጀመሪያው ጥቁር የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት አፈ-ጉባኤ ለመሆን በቅተዋል። ጄፍሪስ የፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕን የስልጣን ዘመን በመቆጣጠር ረገድ ትልቅ ሚና ይኖራቸዋል ተብሎ ቢጠበቅም፣ በፓርቲያቸው ውስጥ ያሉ የለውጥ ፈላጊዎች በእሳቸው አመራር ላይ ተቃውሞ እያሰሙ ነው። እነዚህ አካላት ጄፍሪስ የፓርቲውን የአመራር አካል በመወከል ላይ ብቻ ያተኮሩ ናቸው በማለት እና በእስራኤል ላይ ያላቸውን አቋም በመቃወም ሌላ እጩ እንዲመረጥ እየጠየቁ ነው።
oromo: Bu'aa filannoo giddu-galeessa Ameerikaa kanaan booda, Hakeem Jeffries jalqabaa irratti af-yaa'ii Mana Maree Bakka Bu'oota Ummataa Ameerikaa kan ta'an nama gurraacha jalqabaa ta'uuf qophiirra jiru. Jeffries yeroo darbii mootummaa Donald Trump to'achuu irratti gahee guddaa kan qaban ta'us, miseensonni paartichaa gartuu duraa (progressive) ta'an adeemsa isaa irratti mormii qabu. Namoonni kunneen akka jedhanitti, Jeffries yaada paartichaa qofa kan hordofan ta'uu fi ilaalcha isaa kan Israa'el irratti qabuun walqabatee filannoo biraa akka barbaadan ibsaniiru.

title: ‘Radical’ or ‘hero’?: France debates leftist candidate Jean-Luc Melenchon
english: Jean-Luc Mélenchon, the leader of the hard-left France Unbowed party, is gaining significant momentum as a major challenger in the upcoming French presidential election. His platform includes bold economic proposals such as lowering the retirement age, raising the minimum wage, and restructuring national debt. While supporters view him as a hero standing up for those struggling with the cost of living, critics argue that his radical policies are unrealistic and could harm the nation's finances.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ የግራ ዘመም ፓርቲ መሪ የሆኑት ዣን-ሉክ ሜለንቾን በሚቀጥለው የሀገሪቱ ፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ ጠንካራ ተወዳዳሪ በመሆን ላይ ይገኛሉ። እሳቸው የጡረታ ዕድሜን ዝቅ ማድረግን፣ ዝቅተኛውን ደመወዝ መጨመርን እና የሀገሪቱን ዕዳ አወቃቀር መለወጥን ጨምሮ በርካታ አዳዲስ የኢኮኖሚ እቅዶችን አቅርበዋል። ደጋፊዎቻቸው የኑሮ ውድነትን በመዋጋት ረገድ ጀግና አድርገው ሲመለከቱት፣ ተቃዋሚዎቹ ግን እነዚህ ሃሳቦች እጅግ አክራሪ እና ለሀገር ኢኮኖሚ አደገኛ እንደሆኑ ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Hoggantoonni paartii gara mirgaatti maxxane kan Faransaay, Jean-Luc Mélenchon, filannoo pirezidaantummaa dhufuuf jedhamu keessatti morkataa cimaa ta'anii mul'achaa jiru. Inni karoora diinagdee kan akka umurii sooramaa gadi buusuu, mindaa xiqqaa dabaluu fi liqii biyyattii haala biraatiin gurmeessuu dabalate dhiyeessee jira. Deeggartoonni isaa rakkoo gatii jireenyaa irratti sagalee ta'ee waan jiruuf akka gootaatti kan ilaalan yoo ta'u, mormitoonni garuu karoora isaa kana kan dhugoomuu hin dandeenye fi dinagdee biyyattiitiif balaa qabaachuu danda'a jedhu.

title: ‘We do not want to die from the cold’: Gaza families struggle as rain floods shelters
english: Families in Gaza are facing extreme hardship as winter storms cause heavy flooding in their makeshift shelters. Despite sacrificing their belongings to purchase better coverings, residents are still unable to stay dry or protected from the elements. Many people are suffering in these difficult conditions, feeling helpless as their temporary homes fail to keep out the cold and rain.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ ቤተሰቦች የክረምት አውሎ ንፋስ መጠለያቸውን በማጥለቅለቁ ለከፍተኛ ችግር ተዳርገዋል። ነዋሪዎች የተሻለ መሸፈኛ ለመግዛት ንብረታቸውን ቢሸጡም፣ የዝናብ መጠለያቸው ውሃን መከላከል አልቻለም። እነዚህ ቤተሰቦች ከቅዝቃዜና ከዝናብ ለመጠበቅ እየታገሉ ሲሆን፣ ጊዜያዊ መጠለያቸውም ለፍላጎታቸው ሳይበቃ በመቅረቱ ለከፍተኛ ስቃይ ተጋልጠዋል።
oromo: Maatiin Gaaza keessa jiraatan obomboleettii gannaatiin godaambaan isaanii waan bishaanin guuteef rakkoo cimaa keessa jiru. Uffata gaarii bitachuuf qabeenya isaanii kan gurguratan ta'us, mana isaanii kan yeroo keessatti roobni sun isaan hin oolchu. Maatiin kun qabbanaafi rooba jalaa bahuuf guyyuu kan rakkatan yoo ta'u, manni isaanii kun jireenya isaaniif gahaa miti.

title: US midterms: Not even Trump's Israel aid stunt could rescue the Republicans
english: On Election Day, President Trump attempted to boost Republican candidates by announcing a plan to cut military aid to Israel, a move driven by polls showing declining American support for such funding. Despite this last-minute effort, the strategy failed as Democrats secured significant victories in the House, Senate, and various governorships. Voters ultimately viewed the announcement as an insincere political stunt that could not distract from more pressing concerns like the economy and immigration.
amharic: የቀድሞው የአሜሪካ ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በምርጫ ዕለት ለሪፐብሊካን እጩዎች ድጋፍ ለማግኘት ሲሉ ለእስራኤል የሚሰጠውን ወታደራዊ እርዳታ እንደሚያቆሙ አስታውቀው ነበር። ይህ ውሳኔ የተደረገው የአሜሪካ ሕዝብ ለእስራኤል የሚደረገውን የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እየተቃወመ በመምጣቱ ነው። ይሁን እንጂ ይህ ስልት ውጤታማ አልሆነም፤ ዲሞክራቶች በኮንግረስ እና በሌሎች የሥልጣን ቦታዎች ትልቅ ድል ተቀዳጅተዋል። መራጮችም ይህንን እርምጃ እንደ ትክክለኛ ፖሊሲ ሳይሆን እንደ ፖለቲካዊ ዘዴ በመቁጠራቸው ምርጫውን ለመለወጥ አልቻለም።
oromo: Guyyaa filannoo, pirezidaantiin Amrikaa Doonaald Tiraamp, namoota paartii riippabiliikaanii deeggaruuf jechuun gargaarsa waraanaa Israa'eliif kennamu dhaabuu akka barbaadan labsuun isaanii ni yaadatama. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame yaada uummataa kan irratti hundaa'ee yoo ta'u, sababni isaas namoonni baay'een gargaarsa gara Israa'el deemu mormu turan. Haa ta'u malee, mala kana fayyadamuun isaanii hin milkoofne; paartiin diimookraatotaa filannoo kana injifachuun bakka bu'oota hedduu argachuu danda'aniiru. Uummannis yaada Tiraamp kana akka mala siyaasaa waqtii filannoo malee akka tarkaanfii dhugaa tokkotti hin ilaalle.

title: ‘We do not want to die from the cold’: Gaza families struggle as rain floods shelters
english: Heavy winter rains have flooded makeshift shelters across the Gaza Strip, leaving displaced families in desperate conditions. Many, like Mansour al-Sakni, have spent their meager savings on protective materials, only to see their living spaces destroyed by the storm. With thousands of distress calls reported, families are now facing the dual threat of harsh cold and homelessness as their temporary housing fails to withstand the weather.
amharic: በጋዛ ሰርጥ የጣለው ከባድ የክረምት ዝናብ ተፈናቃዮች የሚጠለሉባቸውን ጊዜያዊ መጠለያዎች አጥለቅልቋል። እንደ ማንሱር አል-ሳክኒ ያሉ አባወራዎች ቤተሰባቸውን ከዝናብ ለመከላከል የነበራቸውን ጥቂት ገንዘብ ቢያወጡም መጠለያዎቻቸው በጎርፍ ተጎድተዋል። በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች እርዳታ እየጠየቁ ሲሆን፣ ተፈናቃዮች ከቦምብ ስጋት ባሻገር አሁን በብርድ እና በመጠለያ እጦት ከፍተኛ ችግር ውስጥ ወድቀዋል።
oromo: Roobni cimaan guyyoota darban Gaza keessatti bu'e bakkeewwan qubannaa yeroo balaa lolaatiin miidhamanii jiru. title: IRGC spokesman announces lifting of restrictions on Iranian missiles
english: A spokesperson for Iran's Revolutionary Guards has officially announced that the country is no longer limiting the range of its missile systems. This decision follows a warning from Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, who promised a powerful response to any future attacks from the United States or Israel. The military has also been instructed to update its target lists to prepare for potential conflicts.

oromo: Dubbi himaan waraana Itoophiyaa kan Iran (IRGC) akka ibsetti, biyyittiin daangaa fageenya xiyyaara kombata ishee irra ture haquu ishee beeksisaniiru. Murteen kun kan dhufey hogganaan biyyattii Ali Khamenei, weerara kamiyyuu kan Ameerikaa ykn Israa'el irraa dhufuluuf deebii cimaa akka kennan akeekkachiisan boodadha. Kana malees, waraanni biyyattii qophii ittisaa fi weeraraa duraan qabu cimsachuuf gosaatota waraanaa isaa haaraa akka godhu ajajamanii jiru.

title: US military looking to expand naval blockade and restrict Iranian land commerce: Report
english: The United States military is establishing a new task force aimed at curbing Iran's ability to transport illegal weapons and restricted goods. This initiative will focus on monitoring and blocking the movement of such items across Iranian land borders and the Caspian Sea. US Central Command is expected to formally announce these expanded efforts to enforce sanctions shortly.

oromo: Waraanni Ameerikaa meeshaalee waraanaa seeraan alaa fi meeshaalee dhorkaman Iran irraa gara biroo akka hin dabarsine ittisuuf garee haaraa hundeessaa jira. Ajajni giddugaleessa Ameerikaa (US Central Command) tarkaanfii sanadaalee cimaa kana akkaataa ifatti beeksisuuf karoorfateera.

title: Paraguay's president impeached and under house arrest after bank collapse
english: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña has been impeached and placed under house arrest following the collapse of Ueno Bank, which left millions of citizens unable to access their savings. Lawmakers removed him from office due to allegations of financial misconduct, conflicts of interest, and the misuse of public funds related to his past business ties. His deputy, Pedro Alliana, has taken over as interim president and pledged to compensate the affected depositors.
amharic: የፓራጓይ ፕሬዝዳንት ሳንቲያጎ ፔኛ የዩኖ ባንክ መክሰርን ተከትሎ ከስልጣን ተወግደው በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል። በሚሊዮኖች የሚቆጠሩ ዜጎች በባንኩ ችግር ሳቢያ ገንዘባቸውን ማግኘት ባለመቻላቸው በተፈጠረው ቁጣ ተከትሎ፣ የህግ አውጭዎች በፕሬዝዳንቱ ላይ የሙስና እና የጥቅም ግጭት ክስ በመመስረት ከስልጣን አውርደዋቸዋል። አዲሱ ጊዜያዊ ፕሬዝዳንት ፔድሮ አሊያና የተጎዱ ዜጎች ገንዘባቸውን መልሰው እንዲያገኙ እንደሚሰሩ ቃል ገብተዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Paraaguwaay Saantiyaagoo Peenyaa bankiin 'Ueno' jedhamu kufuusaa hordofee aangoo irraa kaafamanii mana isaanii akka turan godhaman. title: Pope in 'pretty good health' as he starts Latin America tour
english: Pope Leo XIV has begun a 12-day tour of Latin America, marking his first public appearance since undergoing successful lung cancer surgery three weeks ago. The 71-year-old pontiff confirmed he feels healthy and determined to continue the trip, which includes stops in Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru. During his opening address in Montevideo, he advocated for universal healthcare, noting that his own medical experience highlighted the difficulties many people face in accessing timely treatment.

title: WTA apologises to Pegula for broadcast of ‘diva’ comment about Andreeva
english: The WTA has officially apologized to tennis star Jessica Pegula after a livestream captured her private, disparaging remarks about fellow player Mirra Andreeva. The comments were accidentally broadcast due to technical failures and a lack of proper signage regarding recording equipment on practice courts. WTA leadership admitted the incident was unacceptable, confirming that all audio recording gear has been removed from training areas to protect player privacy.

Rakkoon tekinikaa fi bakka leenjiitti meeshaaleen sagalee waraaban akka jiran mallattoon ifa ta'e kan hin jirreef dogoggora kanaan carraa argate. Hoggantoonni WTA godheen kun fudhatama kan hin qabne ta'uu ibsuun, iccitii taphattootaa eeguuf jecha meeshaaleen sagalee waraaban hundi bakka leenjiirraa akka kaafaman mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Trump confirms US strikes in Iran, insists ‘it’s not a war’
english: Former US President Donald Trump announced that the United States conducted small-scale military strikes against Iran's Qeshm Island. Despite the military action, he emphasized that this does not constitute a full-scale war. These represent the first such attacks reported since the midterm elections.

oromo: Pirezedantiin duraanii Ameerikaa Doonald Traamp, Ameerikaan ganda Qeyshim kan biyya Iraan irratti haleellaa xixiqqoo gaggeessuu ishee mirkaneessaniiru. title: The Error in Tsmido’s Trial and Error
english: Various Ethiopian political and armed groups are forming a loose alliance under the name Tsmido, united solely by their desire to weaken Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government. While they share a common enemy, they lack a unified vision for Ethiopia's future and remain deeply divided on critical issues like territorial integrity and governance. This strategy is highly risky, as it prioritizes immediate power shifts over a long-term political plan, potentially leading to state collapse or further conflict.

title: CDC reports more than 5,000 measles cases, highest number in 35 years
english: The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has recorded over 5,000 measles cases in 2026, marking the highest infection rate in 35 years. The majority of these cases involve children and teenagers, a trend linked to a recent decline in school-age vaccination rates. Furthermore, officials are currently debating how to accurately classify measles-related deaths as the federal data has become a point of political contention.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የበሽታ መቆጣጠሪያ ማዕከል በ2026 ከ5,000 በላይ የኩፍኝ በሽታ እንደተመዘገበ አስታውቋል፤ ይህም በ35 ዓመታት ውስጥ ከፍተኛው ቁጥር ነው። አብዛኛዎቹ ተጠቂዎች ህጻናት እና ታዳጊዎች ሲሆኑ፣ ይህ የቁጥር ጭማሪ በክትባት ሽፋን መቀነስ ጋር የተያያዘ ነው። በአሁኑ ጊዜ በኩፍኝ ምክንያት የሚሞቱ ሰዎችን አቆጣጠር እና ምደባ በተመለከተ በመንግስት ባለስልጣናት መካከል አለመግባባቶች ተፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Itti gaafatamaan to'annoo dhukkubaa Amerikaa (CDC) bara 2026 keessa dhukkubni mancicha (measles) namoota 5,000 ol irratti argamee akka jiru ibseera; kunis waggaa 35 keessatti lakkoofsa olaanaadha. Dhukkubichi kanneen miidhe keessaa hedduun isaanii ijoollee fi dargaggoota yoo ta'an, kunis hir'ina qaqqabbiin talaallii mana barnootaa irratti mul'ateen kan walqabatuudha. Kana malees, lakkoofsa du'a dhukkubichaan walqabatuuf kennamu irratti gidduu mootummaa fi qaolee fayyaa gidduutti falmii fi wal-hubachuu dhabuutu jira.

title: EU prosecutor office investigates fatal train crash in Spain
english: The European Public Prosecutor's Office has initiated an investigation into potential fraud regarding EU funding for Spain's railway network. This probe follows a tragic high-speed train collision in October that resulted in at least 69 deaths. Authorities are specifically examining how funds intended for safety, signaling, and communication upgrades on the Madrid-Seville line were managed by national infrastructure and audit agencies.

title: Paraguay’s Santiago Pena under arrest, new president Pedro Alliana sworn in
english: Paraguay has a new president, Pedro Alliana, who took office after the impeachment and arrest of Santiago Pena. The leadership change was triggered by the sudden collapse of Ueno Bank, which left millions of citizens unable to access their savings. Authorities are currently investigating allegations of financial mismanagement and a potential conflict of interest involving former officials.

title: MTG warns Miller-Wiles shakeup will sink Republican chances in 2028
english: Representative Marjorie Taylor Greene has criticized Donald Trump's decision to appoint Stephen Miller as Chief of Staff. She argues that this personnel change is a strategic move to consolidate power within the Republican Party. Greene further warned that this leadership shakeup could negatively impact the party's chances of winning the 2028 presidential election.

title: Palestinian couples tie the knot in mass wedding in Gaza
english: A total of 250 couples in Gaza participated in a mass wedding ceremony to celebrate their commitment to one another. The event was supported by a humanitarian initiative backed by the UAE called Operation Chivalrous Knight. This celebration offered a moment of joy and hope for the participants amidst the ongoing conflict in the region.

oromo: Gaza keessatti qophii cidha waloo ta'een gaa'elli kan hiyyooman qaxalee 250 ta'u. Sirni cidhaa kun dhaabbata UAE deggaru 'Operation Chivalrous Knight' jedhamuun kan qophaa'e dha. title: Who is Stephen Miller, Trump’s new White House chief of staff?
english: President Donald Trump has appointed his long-time advisor and immigration policy strategist, Stephen Miller, as the new White House chief of staff. Miller, known for his firm conservative views and vocal support of mass deportation efforts, will replace Susie Wiles in this influential role. His appointment comes at a challenging time, as Democrats prepare to take control of Congress and potentially investigate his past political actions.

title: Protesters break into Microsoft data centre site in Amsterdam
english: Hundreds of protesters in Amsterdam occupied a Microsoft data centre construction site to demonstrate against the rapid expansion of AI infrastructure. Activists argue that these facilities consume excessive amounts of energy and water, and they have voiced concerns about the societal impact of AI technologies. Police eventually removed the demonstrators and arrested nearly 200 individuals during the incident, which is part of a larger series of protests occurring across 15 European countries.

title: Trump promotes Stephen Miller to Chief of Staff ‘to run things well’
english: President Donald Trump has appointed his long-term advisor Stephen Miller as the new White House Chief of Staff. Miller, known for shaping Trump's strict domestic policies, is taking over the role from Susie Wiles. This administrative change follows the Republican Party's loss of control in Congress during the recent midterm elections.
